column3: Adoption lets this program use a database that Open Dental created. It is done once, on a restored copy, never on the live database. It drops the office-only patient column _portal_active_email and its unique index, deletes Open Dental's update files from the database without reading them, blanks the addresses of Open Dental's servers, and sets DataBaseVersion and ProgramVersion to 99.0.0.0 so Open Dental programs can no longer use the copy. Then this program's version markers take over. MyISAM tables have no transactions: take a backup first. Going back means restoring that backup.
